seo.title: HeartLink - Private Matchmaking for Select Indian Families
seo.description: Founder-led matchmaking for select Indian families, co-founded and personally guided by Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva.
seo.ogDescription: Thoughtful matchmaking for select Indian families, combining trusted family networks with relationship guidance.

hero.title: Thoughtful matchmaking for select Indian families.
hero.description: HeartLink is co-founded and personally led by Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva. Together, they combine trusted family networks, thoughtful judgment and relationship guidance.

legacy.title: Marriage is a family decision. We treat it like one.
legacy.lead: Families come to HeartLink when a match needs judgment and real attention - not another biodata exchange.
paragraphs: We look at family background, education, values, lifestyle and long-term fit. Introductions move ahead only when there is genuine interest on both sides.

audience.title:
Parents feel reassured.
The next generation feels respected.
audience.description: Parents want background, seriousness and trust. Sons and daughters want compatibility, comfort and a real say in the decision. HeartLink holds both, equally.

cards.label: For parents & families
cards.title: Strong family understanding.
cards.description: Before any introduction is made, we understand family values, reputation, education, profession and social standing - properly, not from a form alone.

cards.label: For sons & daughters
cards.title: Modern compatibility. No app culture.
cards.description: We take the time to understand personality, goals and what you actually want. Introductions are few, private and yours to say yes or no to.

registry.title: Join the Registry. Be considered when the fit is right.
registry.lead: A free way to introduce your family to HeartLink before a search begins.
paragraphs: If an active mandate appears relevant, we contact you before sharing any details.

founderHeading.title: Two founders. One thoughtful process.
founderHeading.description: Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva bring two equally important perspectives to every serious introduction.

founders.name: Gopi Shah
founders.summary: Gopi brings trusted family networks, community experience and practical matchmaking judgment.

founders.name: Alpa Apoorva
founders.summary: Alpa brings relationship insight, emotional clarity and guidance for individuals and families.

finalCta.title:
Looking for a serious match?
Start with a conversation.
finalCta.description: Tell us about your family and the person seeking a match. Relevant enquiries are reviewed by the founder-led team.
